quizzes.sentence: She can't concentrate. She keeps ____ in her studies.
quizzes.why: fall behind＝遅れをとる、ついていけなくなること。

quizzes.sentence: His argument was clear and well-structured — truly ____.
quizzes.why: coherent＝論理的で筋が通っている。

quizzes.sentence: Stop ____! Just tell me what's wrong.
options: hitting the nail on the head
quizzes.why: beat around the bush＝本題を避けて遠回しに言うこと。
